desc: Derive the per-vitamin 0/1 knapsack transition and ensure each food is processed in descending calorie order.
Decide how to convert each vitamin’s DP table into “minimum calories needed for target intake `m`”.
Establish safe binary-search bounds using total available vitamin amounts.
Prove feasibility is monotonic, so binary search is valid.
Implement the complete stdin/stdout Python solution and validate it on the provided samples.
